item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must act before that threshold—not count on an off switch afterward.

2. We reject the promise that we can build superintelligent AI now and regain control later. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We demand prevention, not promises.

3. We have to make the decisive choices before superintelligent AI starts running. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down. We refuse to treat an irreversible decision as an experiment we can simply stop.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We cannot build our future on the comforting fiction that an off switch will save us. We must make the consequential decisions now, while we still have the power to decide what gets built. We demand enforceable limits on development, public accountability, and a refusal to confuse technical ambition with permission to impose irreversible risks. We are not waiting for a demonstration that comes too late. We are organising to prevent a threshold from being crossed that we cannot uncross.
